purpose: Build reproducible Chroma indexes with isolated persistence and query tests.

trigger: Create a local Chroma collection for the RAG experiment
Query an existing Chroma vector database
Migrate embeddings into a separate test Chroma index
do_not_trigger: Summarize a paper without data indexing

preflight: Pin collection, embedding model/version, distance metric and source licenses.
Use isolated test data and an explicit database persistence directory.
workflow: Inspect collection metadata and expected dimension.
Upsert only authorized documents with stable IDs and idempotency.
Run retrieval checks on known queries and inspect scores.
Read back collection count and persistence snapshot.

evidence.how_to_verify: Capture source data, embedding dimension, collection ID and version.
Read back index/collection state and stable document ID coverage.
Verify query hits and distance/scoring behavior on labeled fixtures.

failure_modes: Never replace an existing collection after a dimension mismatch.
If persistence is uncertain, inspect IDs before retrying inserts.
